title: agv_pista_rp_r

specs.material: Carbon Fiber Composite Shell with ABS Impact Liner
specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

technical_analysis: Features 100% 3K Carbon Fiber shell construction developed under AGV Extreme Safety protocol for MotoGP performance paired with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view. The interior utilizes 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
technical_analysis_2: Acoustic and thermal management are addressed through the integrated 'Aerodynamic Ventilation System' (AVS). This design features strategically placed intake and exhaust ports that utilize Bernoulli's principle to create a natural airflow channel, significantly reducing cabin noise at highway speeds while maintaining optimal cooling efficiency. The result is a reduction in perceived wind noise by approximately 3 decibels compared to standard full-face designs of similar weight.
technical_analysis_3: Ergonomics are prioritized through the 'Rapid Fit' internal suspension system, which allows for micro-adjustments to the crown depth and cheek pad tension. The magnetic quick-release strap mechanism not only enhances convenience but also ensures a secure retention force distribution that minimizes pressure points during high-G cornering maneuvers, making it ideal for track days and aggressive street riding.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for Intermediate Oval head shape. Features a low-profile fit with ample clearance at the occiput.

yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the AGV agv_pista_rp_r. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.
marketing_description: Experience the AGV agv_pista_rp_r: combining Italy 🇮🇹 craftsmanship with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view and 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

description: The AGV Pista Rp R is purpose-built for closed-course competition and apex carving, purpose-built for riders demanding uncompromising high-speed aerodynamic stability and track-certified protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1329g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~93 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by a glove-friendly quick-release ratcheting buckle for confident all-day riding.
yoast_title: AGV agv_pista_rp_r: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
introduction: Positioned in AGV's Full Face lineup, the agv_pista_rp_r brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 track safety.
story:
The AGV Pista Rp R represents AGV's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~93 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the AGV Pista Rp R delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
